known_for: LiDAR-powered mobile scanning that turns spaces, plans, and point clouds into 99% accurate, editable CAD and BIM as-builts compatible with leading professional design software.
mission: Create a digital twin of every interior, transform it into structured data via AI, and power the full lifecycle of a property.
vision: Make property reality capture and analysis more accessible and impactful using AI and mobile-device LiDAR technology.

platform_overview.type: Spatial Intelligence Platform (Scan to CAD, Plan to CAD, Point Cloud to BIM)
platform_overview.target_market: Architects, interior designers, contractors, and multi-site commercial operators
platform_overview.core_value: Fast, accurate, editable as-built documentation captured with an iPhone or iPad
platform_overview.capture_method: Mobile-device LiDAR scanning enhanced by proprietary 3D sensing technology
platform_overview.accuracy: Typically within 1-2% of manual field measurements
platform_overview.experience: 15+ years in 3D sensing and computer vision

Scan to CAD.description: LiDAR-powered iPhone or iPad scans transformed into accurate, editable CAD and BIM as-builts
Scan to CAD.capture: Scan a space in minutes with a supported iOS device
Scan to CAD.output: As-built CAD files, floor plans, and measurement reports

Plan to CAD.description: Upload an existing 2D floor plan and convert it into editable 3D CAD models

Point Cloud to BIM.description: Convert point cloud data into structured BIM models

Web Viewer.description: Interactive 3D viewer for sharing, measuring, and annotating models in the browser
capabilities: Share and collaborate without CAD software

Integrations (SDK + API).description: SDK and API access for integrating Twindo reality capture and spatial data into custom workflows

platform_features.LiDAR Reality Capture: Proprietary process enhances Apple device LiDAR sensors for greater accuracy and detail than standard scanning apps
platform_features.AI Segmentation & Measurement: AI-powered segmentation and measurement technology reduces errors and produces design-ready models
platform_features.99% Accuracy: As-built measurements typically within 1-2% of manually verified field measurements
platform_features.Editable & Layered Files: Outputs are editable, layered, and design-ready for immediate use in professional software
platform_features.Reference Dimensions: Manually verified field measurements can be submitted to override scan data where needed
platform_features.Fast Turnaround: Spaces under 1,000 sqft are typically returned in about two business days, with optional rush delivery
platform_features.Spatial Data & Digital Twins: Reality capture converted into structured spatial data across CAD/BIM, APIs, and 3D visualizations

3D CAD / BIM Models.description: Editable, layered, design-ready 3D models compatible with leading professional software

2D Floor Plans.description: Editable AutoCAD file for two-dimensional design plus a shareable PDF for collaboration

Measurement Report.description: Schedule of quantities and key dimensions for floors, walls, doors, windows, and countertops for bidding and takeoffs

Web Viewer.description: Interactive 3D web viewer to view, measure, annotate, and share models with no CAD software required

Draft.description: Instant simplified models generated directly from a scan

Exteriors.description: 3D scanning and modeling of single-story and most two-story building exteriors

supported_devices: iPhone 12 Pro / Pro Max or newer

use_cases.As-Built Documentation: Create accurate existing-conditions models to begin design and construction projects
use_cases.Remodels & Renovations: Capture spaces quickly to plan renovations without repeat site visits
use_cases.Bidding & Takeoffs: Use measurement reports for schedules of quantities and accurate bids
use_cases.Collaboration & Sharing: Share interactive 3D models with clients and teams through the web viewer
use_cases.Floor Plan Conversion: Turn existing 2D floor plans into editable 3D models with Plan to CAD
use_cases.Exterior Modeling: Scan and model building exteriors alongside or independent of interiors
use_cases.Multi-Site Standardization: Produce consistent spatial documentation across retail, QSR, and residential portfolios

Architects.description: As-built CAD and BIM documentation to start projects from accurate existing conditions

Interior Designers.description: Editable, design-ready models so designers spend less time measuring and more time designing

General Contractors.description: Accurate measurements and floor plans for remodels, bids, and takeoffs

Multi-Family Residential.description: Scalable scanning and modeling across apartments, units, and residential portfolios

Multi-Site Retail.description: Consistent as-built documentation across distributed store locations

Quick Service Restaurants.description: Standardized spatial data for QSR rollouts, remodels, and site planning

Hospitality.description: Reality capture and as-builts for hotels and hospitality properties

Fire Safety.description: Accurate building documentation to support fire safety planning and compliance

pricing.model: Subscription tiers with per-square-foot as-built conversion pricing

Starter.description: Pay only for the as-built conversions you need

Essentials.description: Discounted conversion pricing, more projects, and priority support for solo pros to small teams

Scale.description: Annual plans with no project limit, priority delivery, dedicated account manager, and team accounts

commercial.description: Custom pricing for all spaces larger than 8,000 sqft

company_history: Originated from Occipital, a pioneer in 3D sensing hardware and software
Built RedLaser, a barcode-scanning app with over two million downloads, later acquired by eBay
Created the Structure Sensor, the first mobile 3D sensor, funded through a $1.2M Kickstarter campaign
Featured in Apple's 2020 keynote introducing built-in iPhone LiDAR
Transitioned from a hardware focus to an AI and software-focused spatial intelligence platform
